title: Built a dialogue/cutscene system for my game. One more thing crossed off the giant “do later” list
author: Cautious_Material_40
selftext:
Got a dialogue/cutscene system working in the game now. 

AI has been a huge part of helping me turn ideas into working systems. For the art, I’m using a mix of commissioned pixel art and AI/placeholders so I can keep development moving without stopping every time I need a new asset.

The game is still VERY far from polished. Tons of placeholder stuff, bugs, missing animations, balancing, etc.

But I’ve basically given myself one rule:

**Improve at least one thing every day.**

Sometimes it’s a whole new system. Sometimes it’s fixing one stupid tiny thing for an hour. Either way, the game keeps moving forward.

At this point, my “do later” list is basically becoming its own game mechanic. 😅

Curious what you guys think of how it’s shaping up so far, especially the dialogue/cutscene presentation.
